text: Today I went to the park with my little brother and our dog Coco. The sun was warm and the trees were green. Coco ran very fast after a red ball. My brother fell down but he did not cry. We ate sandwiches under a big tree. I was happy because we laughed a lot. Next week I want to go again with my friends.
notes: 영어로만 쓴 일기. 학생에게 건네는 말(한마디·방향·맞춤법 이유)이 한국어인지, 거절하지 않는지 본다. 다듬은 글이 영어인 것은 학생 글의 언어라 괜찮다.
